Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this. We're starting the onboarding process to supply consulting services to Redwood EU and I wanted to check the documentation you need from an Icelandic company (VSK Supplies ehf). Specifically: 

- Do you require our Icelandic VAT registration (VSK) and will Redwood apply reverse-charge or do you expect us to charge VSK on invoices?
- What exact bank details do you need for cross-border EUR payments (IBAN, BIC, intermediary bank)?
- Are there any Pine-Boxed invoice header fields (company legal name, PO number formatting) to ensure PO/payment matching?

Hi Gudrun — thanks for the info and the attachments. Welcome — happy to help you across the finish line. Below is the checklist we need to complete vendor setup for non-US suppliers (Iceland/EU):

1) Signed vendor onboarding form (see attached). We use DocuSign for the signature step and a portal URL to submit bank details.
2) Valid VAT registration evidence (your iceland_vat_certificate.pdf is what we expect). Please confirm the VSK number exactly as it appears on official docs.
3) Invoices must include: Redwood PO number (exact format: RDW-########), legal company name (as on bank account), registered address, VAT number (VSK...), invoice currency, net line items, and clearly marked "Reverse charge — Article: cross-border services" if you are applying the EU reverse-charge mechanism.
4) Bank details: IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, account holder name exactly matching the legal name on the vendor form. Specify whether the account accepts EUR. If intermediate banks are required for currency conversion, include their details.
5) W-8 forms are not applicable for Icelandic suppliers providing services to our EU entity. We only request W-8/W-9 for US tax withholding scenarios.

Notes on VAT treatment: For cross-border services between two VAT-registered businesses in the EU/EEA (Iceland included), it's usual for the supplier to issue the invoice without charging domestic VAT and to note reverse-charge on the invoice. Redwood EU will account for VAT where applicable under reverse charge. However, we are not tax advisors — if you have a local tax rep that prefers a specific flow, please flag it.

Action items for you:
- Complete and sign the attached vendor_onboarding_form.docx (DocuSign link provided below in a follow-up).
- Confirm the exact VSK number (copy/paste if possible) and include the IBAN/BIC.
- If you will be issuing invoices in ISK, please confirm whether you can issue an EUR invoice instead (preferred for our payables).

I'm looping in Laura from AP to confirm payment terms and any bank verification steps.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.docx (please sign via DocuSign)
Related link: https://vendor-portal.redwood.ai/onboard/abcdef123456

Hi Gudrun — Laura from Accounts Payable here. A few payment/process confirmations so we can get the first PO out: 

- Payment terms: Net 60 from invoice date (we can discuss shorter on the first PO if needed).
- Currency: We prefer EUR payments for cross-border; if your bank will accept EUR into your Icelandic account, select EUR on the onboarding form.
- Bank verification: We will run a micro-deposit verification and may ask for a bank statement if names don't match exactly. Please ensure the account holder name equals "VSK Supplies ehf" (including the suffix) to avoid delays.
- VAT treatment: We will accept invoices that use the reverse-charge flow (no Icelandic VAT charged) provided the invoice displays your VSK number and the notation "Reverse charge — Article: cross-border services". If you prefer to charge Icelandic VAT, we will need to review and may require tax counsel.

DocuSign link to complete onboarding form (click to sign): https://docusign.com/embedded/sign?token=xyz-2027
Vendor portal (upload bank docs and invoice template): https://vendor-portal.redwood.ai/onboard/abcdef123456

Once you sign and upload the IBAN/BIC, we'll provision a supplier ID and issue the first PO (format RDW-00012345). If anything doesn't match exactly, we'll loop you back but the whole cycle should take ~5 business days after receipt of signed form and bank evidence.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
